regime_context: China A-shares show an extreme one-narrative regime: Coal holds a 0.25 headline weight and dominates the ranks (score 0.992) with cash-like 0.5 balance, while rotation eligibility is narrow (only 2 of 22 themes eligible). The backtest verdict explicitly flags that the absolute-trend gate did NOT hold on this market's history (gate_helps: false), momentum rank-IC is ~0, and rotation timing has no validated edge, so leadership concentration here is a focus/attention lens, not a prediction.
emerging_watch: Watch Gold Miners (unscorable, no ETF proxy) — top-2 score 0.935 but INEligible and 0.0 breadth with a 0.31 durability bar. If Gold Miners become trend-eligible with breadth above 0.4 on two consecutive detector prints, that would mark a confirmed handoff away from the Coal one-narrative; until then it is not a call.

theses.subject: Coal
theses.thesis: Coal is the only eligible, scorable theme with trend-gate approval and top momentum rank (0.992), forming a clear one-narrative concentration. The lean is a continuation bet on existing leadership rather than a momentum signal, since rank alone has ~0 predictive edge; the mean-revert hurst tag and thin 0.5 breadth temper conviction.
theses.dissent: Hurst tag is mean-revert, not trend — on this whipsaw-prone tape (gate_helps false) the leadership could quickly reverse, and Coal's breadth of 0.5 suggests the move is not broadly confirmed.

falsifier.text: 515220.SS (Coal proxy) closes below its 10-day moving average for 5 consecutive trading days before the check-by date

theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks are eligible with high durability (0.83), full breadth (1.0), and trend hurst tag, but carry a crowding flag (crowded=true, z 1.83). Crowding is a size-down caution only, not a fade signal, so a modest continuation lean is defensible on the trend-health leg alone.
theses.dissent: Crowding z of 1.83 is the highest in the universe — this is the reflexive fade-failure zone the guardrails warn about, and directional accuracy on this market (0.337) is weak.

falsifier.text: 512800.SS (Banks proxy) underperforms the CSI 300 by 3% over a 10-day rolling window before the check-by date
